scope: New independent mathematical applications, refusal boundaries, bilingual lexical retrieval, complete refs closure. No empirical power or LLM application claim.

prior_result_search.query: normal-mixture|Freedman|freedman in prior result metadata; sequential accumulated noise adaptive variance budget in published knowledge
prior_result_search.reuse: Published Freedman, betting, alpha-spending supply comparisons only; no prior pass reused for this distinct moving intrinsic-time boundary. Historical candidate bodies and reserved target answers not read.

cases.setup: A calibration instrument selects amplitude a_t=1 or 2 using the sign of S_(t-1), then observes D_t=a_t Z_t with fresh standard normal Z_t. Use sigma_t²=a_t², rho=3, delta=.07.
cases.expected: Valid despite adaptation and unbounded increments; proxy predictable. All-time two-sided bound applies, unlike bounded-increment Freedman.

cases.setup: A controller picks a_t in {0.5,1.5} from past state; independent fair Rademacher epsilon_t gives D_t=a_t epsilon_t. Enumerate adaptive paths up to depth 14, rho=.7, delta=.2.
cases.expected: Conditional cosh MGF <= exp(lambda² a_t²/2). Exact finite-horizon crossing mass <= delta is a sanity check only, not proof of infinite horizon.

cases.setup: D is +10 or -10 each with probability .005, otherwise zero. Mean zero and variance one. Propose sigma²=1 solely because it equals conditional variance.
cases.expected: Reject proxy: at lambda=1 the MGF .99+.01 cosh(10) exceeds exp(.5). Finite variance is insufficient.

cases.setup: Draw one fair sign Z and take D_t=Z at every time. Each marginal is centered and 1-subGaussian. Propose sigma_t²=1 with natural history.
cases.expected: Reject: after first observation conditional mean is Z, not zero; S_t grows linearly and eventually violates the proposed sublinear bound almost surely.

cases.setup: Inspect data then optimize rho over all positive numbers, reporting the same delta for the minimized boundary.
cases.expected: Reject uncalibrated data-dependent tuning; fixed rho, external independent tuning or separately calibrated mixture/union budget required.

cases.setup: All sigma_t²=0. Evaluate V=0 at rho=.125, delta=.01 and compare with S=0.
cases.expected: All D_t=0 a.s.; positive threshold sqrt(2rho log(1/delta)); M_0=1 and no crossing. rho=0 is excluded.

cases.setup: Stop at first |S_t| >= b(V_t), with tau=infinity if never crossed.
cases.expected: P(tau<infinity)<=delta; do not reinterpret as conditional-on-stopping error or claim stopping is finite.

cases.setup: Conditional MGF domination is certified only for lambda>=0 or |lambda|<=.1; use the full real-line Gaussian mixing density unchanged.
cases.expected: Reject this proof and two-sided formula: mixing integrates all real lambda and needs corresponding domination.

cases.setup: Change physical units by c=7: S'=cS,V'=c²V,rho'=c²rho.
cases.expected: b(V',rho',delta)=c b(V,rho,delta), and mixture capital unchanged; rho has squared-increment units.

acceptance.scientific: All nine cases reviewed against actual complete candidate; mathematical gap is blocking.
acceptance.numerical: MGF counterexample strict; integration relative error <1e-8; boundary algebra <1e-12; exact adaptive-tree crossing <=delta.
acceptance.refs: Complete recursive requires closure; real published dependency versions; changed digest and omitted dependency rejected. Candidate itself may be unpublished during prepublication review.
acceptance.retrieval: At least four of six fresh queries contain target in top five including one query in each language. Failures preserved; no query rewriting after results.
